title: ElmTech: urgent latency regression after model-3a-v5 rollout
text:
ElmTech: urgent latency regression after model-3a-v5 rollout

["From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@elmtech.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ElmTech SRE <sre@elmtech.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Sudden p95 increase after model-3a-v5 deployment

Hi Karthik,

We're seeing a sharp regression in inference latency after you rolled model-3a-v5 into our production route at ~02:30 UTC this morning. Our synthetic and real traffic show p95 jump from ~320ms to 780–920ms and error rates remain low, so this looks like a perf regression rather than errors.

Impact: our user-facing chat features degrade (timeouts for some clients) and our SLA target of p95 <= 400ms is now being missed consistently for the last 6 hours. We've attached a perf dump and flame graphs from our traces.

Can your team confirm whether there's a known change in kernel selection or batching behavior with v5? If there's a quick mitigation (fallback to v4 or a config change), we need that action within the hour — otherwise we will open a formal SLA exception request and consider throttling.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Platform
ElmTech

Attachments: perf_dump_20270219.json (trace), flame_v5.svg
", "From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@elmtech.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:38:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 increase after model-3a-v5 deployment

Hi Marta — thanks for the signal and the perf dump. We're looking at this now.

On Sat, 20 Feb 2027 at 09:12 AM Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@elmtech.com> wrote:
> We're seeing a sharp regression in inference latency after you rolled model-3a-v5 into our production route at ~02:30 UTC this morning.

Preliminary triage: our telemetry shows an increase in KV-cache misses with v5 on medium-length sessions (seq len ~512), and the runtime fell back to a conservative attention kernel that increases per-token latency under certain memory pressure patterns. We can do one of two immediate mitigations:

1) Roll ElmTech's route back to model-3a-v4 (full rollback to the previous verified binary), or
2) Apply a config patch that forces the alternative attention kernel pairing and reduces batch sizes for ElmTech (lower throughput but likely restores p95).

Grace/Hannah — can you authorize a rollback to v4 for this customer while we complete a post-mortem? Because this will be a cross-cutting change (affects routing and reserved pools), I need an explicit approval to proceed. If approved, I can schedule the rollback within 30 minutes and monitor.

Marta — which option do you prefer? If you want rollback, I will coordinate and share a short change log and expected impact window.

— Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
", "From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@elmtech.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 increase after model-3a-v5 deployment

Karthik — authorize the rollback to model-3a-v4 for ElmTech.

We should treat this as a customer-impacting regression and record an SLA exception for audit and billing reconciliation. Hannah, please add a short post-incident note in INF-9123 and start the SLA exception workflow (use the attached form). Finance may need to review any crediting.

Marta — we authorize the rollback. Please expect a 15–45 minute window while we revert ElmTech's route and validate p95. We'll send a confirmation when complete.

Grace O'Connor
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: slo-exception-form.pdf
", "From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@elmtech.com>, ElmTech SRE <sre@elmtech.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 11:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 increase after model-3a-v5 deployment — rollback scheduled

All — rollback to model-3a-v4 is scheduled and will start at 11:15 AM EST (11:15:00 -05:00). Ops runbook:
- Disable model-3a-v5 routing for ElmTech (canary cancellation)
- Drain in-flight requests on v5 nodes for 5 minutes
- Flip route to v4; validate p95 with synthetic profile for 10 minutes
- Confirm to ElmTech and close this thread if p95 returns to baseline

I've attached the rollback-notes.md and linked the incident ticket INF-9123 for traceability. Hannah — please keep ElmTech and Finance updated on the SLA exception form and estimated credit window.

Marta — we'll monitor closely and post the validation results inline. Apologies for the disruption and thank you for the quick heads-up.

— Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rollback-notes.md
Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9123
"]
